name: tmc-level-params
description: Level difficulty parameter harness for level designers: from a level range and Normal/Hard/ExHard counts, generate and check per-level totals, kinds, four-category split, targets, stacking, moving vehicles and duration from competitor mainline statistics.

interface.shortDescription: Generate per-level difficulty parameters for a batch of levels.
interface.longDescription: For level designers, not production. Input a level range and how many Normal, Hard and ExHard levels it holds. The harness places the difficulties, draws each level from real competitor levels near the same position, checks every level and the batch, and writes level-params.json/csv/xlsx. Items are placeholders (building 1, prop 3); level production binds them to a theme. Standard library only; xlsx export needs xlsxwriter.
defaultPrompt: 生成 101–150 关的难度参数：Normal 35 关，Hard 10 关，ExHard 5 关。
看一下 120 关的参数和依据。
复查这份 level-params.json 是否还通过全部检查。
